snippet.title: Veterans: Napoleonic Wars — New Units, Weather, and Visual Enhancements | Dev Blog #3
snippet.description:
Link to Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4202430/Veterans_Napoleonic_Wars/

We’re excited to share our third devblog video! Take a look at the new tactical and visual updates coming to Veterans: Napoleonic Wars. Observe the new Deployment Phase, allowing you to position your troops before the fight begins. We are also showcasing atmospheric additions like volumetric smoke and rain, along with new units: Generals and Ammo Supply wagons.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Take command of the 19th-century battlefield. Veterans: Napoleonic Wars is an intense real-time battle simulator that puts you in the boots of a frontline general. There is no need to establish a base, do only what you want to and focus on thousands of soldiers awaiting your orders, and the smell of black powder in the air.
